verdict.rationale: Mem0 documents an official MCP server that lets any MCP-compatible client (Claude, Cursor, etc.) connect to the same hosted memory store, plus explicit plugins for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex, and a one-command way to point multiple clients at the hosted server, all backed by user/agent/app-scoped memory so different tools share the same persistent memory. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that ChatGPT specifically integrates via MCP/plugin (only Claude/Cursor/Codex are named) and no third-party report validating cross-tool memory sharing in practice.
